preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 and at most 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes and there must be no loops or multiple edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str((p * pow(q, M - 2, M)) % M)
postconditions.description: The output must be the variance of the number of connected components modulo 10^9 + 7.
